# Synthetic receipt fixtures

`receipt.png` and `receipt.heic` were generated locally using Pillow 12.3.0 and
pillow-heif 1.8.0. They contain a drawn 700 × 1000 test receipt explicitly marked
SYNTHETIC RECEIPT / TEST DATA ONLY, with fictional apples (USD 4) and bread (USD 6).
No real receipt, purchase, user information, or third-party image is included.
The HEIC fixture tests actual decoding and lossless original-file download; it
is not evidence of an actual iPhone camera or Safari test.
